component.name: Process Traffic
component.summary: See and control what every app on your computer talks to

description.p: Process Traffic shows a live map of which apps are talking to which internet hosts, how much data moves, how healthy each connection is, and which firewall rule allowed it — or that the firewall blocked it.

ul.li: Every fact says how it was measured: exact, derived or inferred, with its source
Connection health from the kernel's own round-trip and resend counters
Disconnect, block a host or block an app, with undo
A command-line companion (ptctl) for scripts and AI assistants

description.p: Everything is read on this computer. Nothing is sent anywhere.
